chunks: And by this chain, it is that the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) complained of his eye, so the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) visited him.
So when he was screaming, the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Is it panic or pain?' So he said: 'O Messenger of Allah! I have not experienced a pain at all more intense than it.'
So he said: 'O Ali! When the Angel of Death descends to capture the soul of the Infidel, a skewer of fire descends along with him. So he removes his soul with it, and Hell shrieks out.'
So Ali (peace be upon him) sat up straight and said: 'O Messenger of Allah! Repeat your hadith to me, for what you said has made me forget my pain.'
Then he said: 'Would anyone from your community be hit by that?' He said: 'Yes, an unjust ruler, and the consumer of the wealth of the orphan unjustly, and the false testifier.'
ai.seo_question: Who among the community of the Prophet will experience the same pain as Hell's shriek when the Angel of Death comes for them?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) cures Imam Ali’s severe eye pain by reminding him of the intense suffering of the disbelievers at the hands of the Angel of Death, illustrating the concept of *shifa* through spiritual reflection. The hadith specifically identifies three categories of sinners—unjust rulers, those who devour orphans' wealth, and false witnesses—as those who will experience this fiery extraction, linking physical affliction to eschatological punishment. This incident highlights the unique status of Imam Ali, whose pain was alleviated by the Prophet’s words, while also providing a concrete theological basis for the fate of specific social transgressors.

en.sarwar: 10. It is narrated through the same chain of narrator, as the above Hadith, the following: “Amir al-Mu’minin, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, was suffering from a severe eye illness and the Holy Prophet visited him for this reason.
He groaned loudly because of severe pain. The Holy Prophet said, ‘Is it impatience or severe pain?’ He replied, ‘O Messenger of Allah, I have never experienced such a severe pain.’

He said, ‘O Ali, when the angel of death goes to remove the soul of an unbeliever from his body, he takes with him a number of roasting bars of fire with which he removes his (unbeliever’s) soul from his body, and then hell roars.’
Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, then sat upright saying, ‘O Messenger of Allah, please repeat what you just said; it made me forget the severe pain altogether.’

He then asked, ‘Will anyone from your followers face such a condition?’ The Messenger of Allah replied, ‘Yes, an unjust ruler, those who unjustly consume the property of orphans and those who present a false testimony.’”
